# randomkeygen.com

> RandomKeygen is a free, open-source browser-based toolkit for generating secure passwords, API keys, UUIDs, JWT secrets, encryption keys and related values, with security guides for developers and general users.

## Pages

- [RandomKeygen - Free Secure Password & Key Generator](https://randomkeygen.com): Professional keygen toolkit: generate secure passwords, API keys, UUIDs, JWT secrets, encryption keys, and more. Free, open-source, runs entirely in your browser.
- [AES-256 Key Generator - Create Secure 256-bit Encryption Keys Online | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/aes-256-key): Generate cryptographically secure AES-256 encryption keys and initialization vectors instantly. Support for CBC, GCM, CTR cipher modes with hex, base64 output formats for symmetric encryption.
- [AES Key Generator - 128/192/256-bit Keys | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/aes-key): Generate secure AES encryption keys in 128-bit, 192-bit, and 256-bit sizes. Includes initialization vectors for CBC and GCM cipher modes.
- [AI Key Generator - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI & Custom Formats | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/ai-key-generator): Generate secure AI API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, and custom AI providers. AI-specific formats, rate limiting presets, and key security best practices for developers.
- [API Key Generator - Custom Prefixes & Lengths | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/api-key): Generate secure API keys for REST, GraphQL, OAuth, and custom applications. Choose a prefix, length, permissions, version, and rate-limit preset.
- [Backup Codes Generator - 2FA Recovery Codes | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/backup-codes): Generate secure backup codes for two-factor authentication recovery. Like Google and GitHub style 2FA backup codes for account recovery.
- [Base32 Encoder - Convert Text to Base32 Encoding Online](https://randomkeygen.com/base32-encode): Free online Base32 encoder tool. Convert text, URLs, and data to Base32 encoding instantly. Supports RFC 4648 standard with padding options.
- [Bcrypt Hash Generator - Hash Passwords with Salt | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/bcrypt-generator): Generate secure bcrypt password hashes with configurable cost factors. Free online bcrypt generator for developers and secure password storage.
- [Bulk Password Generator - Generate Multiple Passwords & CSV Export | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/bulk-password-generator): Generate hundreds of secure passwords at once. Export to CSV for easy import into spreadsheets, user management systems, and onboarding workflows.
- [Test Credit Card Generator - Generate Valid Test Card Numbers | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/credit-card-generator): Generate valid test credit card numbers for development and testing. Creates Luhn-valid card numbers for Visa, Mastercard, Amex. For testing only - not real cards.
- [Developer Generators - API Keys, JWT Secrets, UUIDs & Tokens | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/developer): Every RandomKeygen developer tool in one place: API keys, JWT secrets, UUIDs, OAuth tokens, TOTP setup keys, and framework secrets. Generated locally, never transmitted.
- [Django SECRET_KEY Generator - Production-Ready Keys](https://randomkeygen.com/django-secret-key): Generate production-ready Django SECRET_KEY values with proper entropy. Compatible with all Django versions. Includes code examples for settings.py and environment variables.
- [Encryption Key Generators - AES, RSA, Salts & Hashing | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/encryption): Every RandomKeygen encryption tool in one place: AES keys, RSA key pairs, HMAC secrets, salts, and hashing utilities. Generated locally with the Web Crypto API, never transmitted.
- [Encryption Key Generator - AES Keys & IVs | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/encryption-key): Generate cryptographically secure encryption keys for AES-128, AES-192, and AES-256. Includes initialization vectors (IVs) for CBC and GCM modes.
- [Flask Secret Key Generator - Generate Secure SECRET_KEY | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/flask-secret-key): Free Flask secret key generator. Generate cryptographically secure SECRET_KEY values for Flask applications. Protects sessions, cookies, and CSRF tokens.
- [Gaming Password Generator - Xbox, PlayStation, Steam Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/gaming-password): Generate secure passwords for gaming accounts. Perfect for Xbox Live, PlayStation Network, Steam, Epic Games, and other gaming platforms.
- [Hash Generator - MD5, SHA256, SHA512, bcrypt Online | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/hash-generator): Free online hash generator. Create MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and bcrypt hashes instantly. Perfect for password hashing, checksums, and data integrity verification.
- [HMAC Key Generator - SHA-256/384/512 Secrets | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/hmac-key): Generate secure HMAC secrets for message authentication. Supports HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA384, and HMAC-SHA512 with proper key lengths.
- [JWT Secret Key Generator - HS256, HS384 & HS512 | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/jwt-secret): Generate a secure JWT secret key in your browser: 256-bit HS256, 384-bit HS384 or 512-bit HS512, base64 or hex, one-click copy. Free, nothing sent to a server.
- [Keygen Hub - Complete Collection of Key Generators | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/keygen-hub): Comprehensive collection of all key generators in one place. Generate passwords, encryption keys, API tokens, JWT secrets, SSH keys, and more. Free, secure, and instant.
- [Laravel Key Generator - Generate APP_KEY Online | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/laravel-key): Free Laravel APP_KEY generator. Generate secure application keys for Laravel projects. Compatible with php artisan key:generate format (base64:...).
- [Master Password Generator - Password Manager Keys | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/master-password): Generate ultra-secure master passwords for password managers like 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Maximum entropy for your most important password.

Create access tokens, refresh tokens, client secrets with 4-step authorization flow examples, security checklist, and framework implementations.

- [Password Entropy Calculator - Analyze Password Strength & Security | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password-entropy-calculator): Calculate password entropy, strength ratings, and time-to-crack estimates. Analyze character sets, visualize security levels, and get recommendations for stronger passwords.

- [Password Generators - Strong, Memorable & Bulk Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/passwords): Every RandomKeygen password tool in one place: strong random passwords, passphrases, PINs, recovery codes, and strength checkers. Generated locally, never transmitted.

Advanced password generator with manager integration guides.

- [16 Character Password Generator - Extra Strong Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password/16-character): Generate highly secure 16 character passwords. The ideal length for most accounts offering excellent protection against brute force attacks.
- [20 Character Password Generator - Maximum Security Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password/20-character): Generate ultra-secure 20 character passwords. Maximum protection for your most important accounts like banking, email, and password managers.
- [24 Character Password Generator - Strong Random Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password/24-character): Generate secure 24 character passwords with uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Free, private, and generated entirely in your browser.
- [32 Character Password Generator - High-Entropy Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password/32-character): Generate secure 32 character passwords with high entropy. Customize letters, numbers, and symbols; generation stays entirely in your browser.
- [8 Character Password Generator & Examples | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password/8-character): Generate random 8-character passwords with uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, symbols, optional ambiguous-character exclusion, and bulk output.

## Password Generator

- [Letters Only Password Generator - Alphabetic Passwords | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password-generator/letters-only): Generate secure passwords using only letters (A-Z, a-z). No numbers or symbols. Perfect for systems with strict alphabetic-only requirements.
- [Password Generator Without Special Characters - Alphanumeric Only | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password-generator/no-special-characters): Generate secure passwords without special characters or symbols. Perfect for sites that don't allow special characters. Letters and numbers only.
- [Numbers Only Password Generator - Numeric Passwords & PINs | RandomKeygen](https://randomkeygen.com/password-generator/numbers-only): Generate secure numeric-only passwords and PIN codes. Perfect for phone unlock codes, ATM PINs, and systems requiring digit-only passwords.
